dedupe_keys.name: matlab simulation package for reconfigurable intelligent surface ris modeling based on an antenna array like approach

description: University of Bologna researchers publish a MATLAB simulator for reconfigurable intelligent surfaces using a macroscopic antenna-array-like model. The June 2025 Zenodo release provides a program archive and two documentation files, freely available under CC BY 4.0. Users specify transmitter and receiver positions, antenna gains, transmitted power and desired reradiation angles. The surface can operate as an anomalous reflector or focusing lens in reflective or transmissive configurations. Outputs show the electromagnetic field distribution at the receiver plane. The tool can support placement and field-shaping experiments in communication-infrastructure simulations. Coverage is a generic physical model, not an observed network or historical period. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. Required MATLAB version, toolbox dependencies, discretisation and empirical calibration remain unknown. The documented main-program name uses a mat extension, so its launch procedure requires checking in the archive. No code was executed.
